title: adaptive-observability-retention-credits-and-contract-onboarding-playbook
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Run a multi-factor experiment that combines: (1) a granular observability retention credit model (pay-as-you-grow credits + decay rules); (2) a packaged Compliance Pack (security questionnaire automation + audit evidence binder) as a purchasable add-on; and (3) a Premium SLA upsell that can be gated behind an entitlement check. Goal is to measure conversion lift, average contract value, and operational lift for Sales/RevOps while making onboarding for enterprise buyers easier.
acceptance_criteria: Design & Console: retention tier selector UI with three granular options implemented behind a feature flag
Billing: observability credit metering emitted to billing pipeline and visible in per-tenant cost breakdowns
Contracts: Compliance Pack auto-populates standard security questionnaire answers and bundles downloadable artifacts into a zip for legal review
SLA: entitlements gating works end-to-end — customers assigned Premium SLA in Contract flow get SLA metadata in tenant config and routing policy
Metrics: dashboards live in Data Studio showing conversion rate by funnel (trial->paid for add-ons), ARPU delta, and attachment rate to enterprise deals
Security: security_review_required flagged and legal sign-off documented before public rollout
decisions: Use a credit-decay model (30% monthly decay) for 'burst' observability credits to reduce long-term liability
Offer Compliance Pack as a time-limited add-on (first 90 days included in pilot contracts) to reduce friction for initial pilot customers
Premium SLA priced as an MRR uplift with a minimum contract term; enable auto-fallback to standard SLA when entitlement not present
Initial rollout scoped to Dedicated customers and Hosted customers on growth plan to limit blast radius
